Odisha textbook error sparks controversy over song attribution

An eighth-grade textbook in Odisha has drawn criticism for misidentifying the popular song 'Nimbooda Nimbooda' as a folk song, attributing it to actress Aishwarya Rai. This error has led to a significant controversy, with education department officials acknowledging the mistake. The incident highlights concerns about the accuracy of educational materials.
